data.description: Undead are immune to death effects, disease, mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, phantasms, and patterns), paralysis, poison, sleep, stun, and any effect that requires a Fortitude save (unless the effect also works on objects or is harmless). Undead are not subject to ability drain, energy drain, or nonlethal damage. Undead are immune to damage or penalties to their physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution), as well as to fatigue and exhaustion effects. Undead are not at risk of death from massive damage. Mindless - Immune to all mind-affecting effects (charms/ compulsions/ phantasms/ patterns/ and morale effects), Cannot heal damage on own if has no Intelligence score (but can be healed and Fast Healing works)
